caption: The drawing depicts a single standing male figure with dark skin, shown mostly unclothed except for a feathered skirt in multiple colors—red, yellow, and green—and a golden sash draped diagonally across his chest and resting on his right hip. The figure wears a large, ornate headdress with plumed, curved sections in reddish-brown tones and gold banding. He holds a long spear in his left hand, which has a brown shaft and a golden-yellow, leaf-shaped point. In his right hand, he carries a large brown shield with gold accents and an ornate scrollwork design at the top and bottom. His stance is upright, with his left foot slightly forward, standing on a circular, flat green base. The background is plain and unadorned, with a uniform off-white or beige color.
